en.name: Savant
en.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
en.flavor: Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor... the sun sets early but the moon is unchanged... a torn piece of cloth... evil in the manor house... three by three... the one we trusted is not what he seems... green light means magnesium... residue, but the pattern is wrong... Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor...

revisions.v1: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.

zh.name: 博学者
zh.ability: 每个白天，你可以私下询问说书人以得知两条信息：一个是正确的，一个是错误的。
